title: Three Terms and One Short Ruler
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：routine　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 routine 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the teacher ① kept the routine that no pupil in the classroom would have recorded, and he said the keeping was the whole of the term. The ② routine, meaning the habit itself and not the ruler, ran three terms and stayed unrecorded in the book; a routine, he said, is the only thing in a classroom that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ routine in that classroom had the same short ruler beside it, and the ④ routine at the far blackboard, meaning the page they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A routine, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the teacher said the recording is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the routine was the whole of the matter, meaning the order and not the habit. The ⑥ routine, meaning the order and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; routine, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a habit and an order. He said the order is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ routine had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short ruler. The ⑧ routine of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in March, was one classroom and three terms of recording; routine, he said, is either the page at the far blackboard or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ routine I remember is the habit recorded in the notebook, which closed in 1979 and is still recorded as the quietest in the classroom. A ⑩ routine, my mother said in 1981, is the only habit that improves by being recorded; every routine, she said, is an order that has agreed to look like a habit. She said the order was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 常规；例行（指教室里每一套旁边的那一套）
B. n. 常规；例行（指那套常规本身，与短短的尺子相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the routine 保持这一套常规
D. n. 常规；例行（指留给孩子们照着抄的那一页）
E. n. 常规之事（抽象总称，指一处教室的常规之事）
F. n. 常规；例行（指笔记簿里写到、被记载的那一套）
G. n. 常规、条理（指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 条理（抽象总称，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept the routine that no pupil in the classroom would have recorded
The routine, meaning the habit itself and not the ruler
the routine at the far blackboard
the routine was the whole of the matter
the routine had become a line in a notebook
The routine of the whole thing
A routine, my mother said in 1981

answers.why: keep the routine 意为“保持这一套常规”，1972 年那位先生把教室里没有一位学童肯记载的一套常规做了一遍。
routine 意为“常规；例行”，指那套常规本身而不是短短的尺子，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记载。
routine 意为“常规；例行”，指教室里每一套旁边的那一套，每一套旁边都有同一把短短的尺子。
routine 意为“常规；例行”，指最远那块黑板的留给孩子们照着抄的那一页，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
routine 意为“常规、条理”，指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这套条理就是那件事的全部。
routine 意为“条理”，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西而不是那套常规，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
routine 意为“常规；例行”，指笔记簿里写到、被记载的那一套，到 1977 年这一套成了笔记簿里的一行。
routine 意为“常规之事”，先生三月写道，整件事的常规之事是一处教室和三个学期的记载。
routine 意为“常规；例行”，我记得的是笔记簿里记载过的那一套，1979 年教完了，至今仍被说成教室里最安静的一套。
routine 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，常规是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的常规。
